scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically for binary doubly-even codes at generalized order two; finite enumeration is used only as a consistency check. No claim is made for merely even codes, nonbinary divisible codes, higher orders, or exact values of the generalized covering radius. Literature searches cannot prove novelty, and an older equivalent formulation remains a residual risk.
title: A strict second-order packing--covering gap for doubly-even binary codes
